svg.text: Episode 10 - one policy across the design range
Training curves for the conditioned policy, and what it does on each car it was asked about.

[MEASURED] PPO on the double-track model, 5,000,000 steps, ONE policy - front mass fraction resampled 0.40-0.65 per episode - 12 rollouts per design - [ASSUMED] reward = progress; slip envelope penalised at 0.5 per step of excess
Every figure is one seed of training, evaluated over 12 rollouts per design. The spread quoted is across rollouts, not across training seeds.
